description: EXECUTE via POST /v1/capabilities/{key}/jobs and return immediately with a job id (paid). Use when execution is required but this MCP call must not block — not for quotes, receipts, or status. Do NOT use for 'how much would X cost?' (hydracept_quote_capability) or checking an existing job (hydracept_job_status / hydracept_get_receipt). Prefer hydracept_run when wait=true is acceptable. Poll with hydracept_job_status. Auth: bearer required. Cost: same hold/settle as hydracept_run. Side effects: executes the capability; creates a job record.
